value.content:
# situation: on issues opened, a step whose shell: is bash -e {0} writes
#   body= and the issue's body to $GITHUB_ENV.
# reason: the runner runs the script in bash with -e, which reads the
#   script as shell: bash does; anyone who opens an issue writes the body of
#   the issue, and the runner reads $GITHUB_ENV one line at a time as
#   NAME=value, so a line of the body such as BASH_ENV=... becomes a
#   separate variable.
# attack-value: github.event.issue.body = "x\nPWNED=1"
# attack-run-behavior: BODY holds x, a line break and PWNED=1, so echo
#   appends the two lines body=x and PWNED=1 to $GITHUB_ENV; the runner
#   reads each line as NAME=value and sets body to x and PWNED to 1 for the
#   later steps.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - shell: bash -e {0}
        env:
          BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: echo "body=$BODY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
